card.fires_on: The word "under" (or a dash) that points the reader to another named section of the label, such as "described under Indications and Usage" or "see PRECAUTIONS - ...". It comes right before the section title.

modes.description: The word "under" after verbs like described, outlined, mentioned or presented, pointing to a label section.
